copilot.subtitle: Evidence-grounded NTN ops assistant. Every response is constrained to /metrics observations; the model never invents data. Status field tells you which path the response took.

gateways.empty: No gateways. Load a scenario first.
gateways.subtitle: Per-gateway availability + load. orbitops_gateway_available is a binary gauge (0/1); load (0..1) is reported when the emulator exposes orbitops_gateway_load.

metricChart.noHistoryYet: {{title}}: no history yet — wait for the next /metrics scrape (5 s cadence).

overview.empty: No beams. Load a scenario from <1>Scenarios</1>.
overview.subtitle: Cluster-wide health snapshot. Numbers come from the emulator /metrics scrape; the table is the live view of every beam in the active scenario.

checklist.askCopilot: Open the Copilot tab and ask "Which beam is degrading and why?"
checklist.retryHint: Click "Tick + Ns" to retry, or "Load preset" to reset.

scenarios.customLoadFutureWork: Custom-JSON load is VS-3 future work.
scenarios.subtitle: Load a preset scenario, advance the emulator clock with Tick + Ns, then jump straight to Copilot for a grounded answer.
